# American Dental Association

> The American Dental Association (ADA) is the professional organization for dentists, offering membership, continuing education, clinical guidelines, research publications, and advocacy on dental policy and practice standards.

The ADA serves as the primary resource for dental professionals, students, and organizations seeking clinical standards, professional development, licensure guidance, and industry advocacy. The organization publishes peer-reviewed research, maintains the CDT Code for dental procedures, and hosts the annual Scientific Session conference.

## Key Topics

- American Dental Association (ADA)
- Continuing Education (CE)
- Dental Admission Test (DAT)
- INBDE (Integrated National Board Dental Examination)
- CDT Code (Code on Dental Procedures and Nomenclature)
- DENTPIN
- Clinical Guidelines
- Dental Insurance
- Membership
- Scientific Session
- Licensure
- Dental Research
- Practice Management
- Patient Education
- Professional Development

## Membership & Professional Community

- [Join the American Dental Association](https://www.ada.org/join-the-ada): ADA membership enrollment with benefits and resources
- [Renew Your Membership](https://www.ada.org/join-the-ada/renew-ada-membership): ADA membership renewal and member benefits portal
- [ADA 2026 Scientific Session](https://www.ada.org/education/scientific-session): ADA 2026 Scientific Session annual conference in Indianapolis

## Education & Licensure

- [Continuing Education](https://www.ada.org/education/continuing-education): ADA CE courses for professional development and licensure
- [Dental Admission Tests and Exams](https://www.ada.org/education/testing): Dental admission test (DAT) registration and exam resources
- [Licensure Overview](https://www.ada.org/resources/careers/licensure): Dental licensure requirements and INBDE exam guidance
- [CODA Program Finder](https://www.ada.org/education/coda-program-finder): Search CODA-accredited dental education programs and schools
- [Manage your DENTPIN](https://www.ada.org/education/manage-your-dentpin): DENTPIN account management for dental education tracking

## Research & Publications

- [JADA (Journal of American Dental Association)](https://www.ada.org/publications/jada): Journal of American Dental Association peer-reviewed research
- [JADA Foundational Science](https://www.ada.org/publications/jada-foundational-science): JADA Foundational Science open-access dental research journal
- [The Code on Dental Procedures and Nomenclature (CDT Code)](https://www.ada.org/publications/cdt): CDT Code standards for dental procedures and insurance claims

## Practice Resources & Store

- [ADA Store Homepage](https://engage.ada.org/pages/storehome): ADA Store for dental products, CE courses, and practice resources
- [ADA Store Products](https://www.ada.org/publications/ada-store-products): ADA professional resources, patient education, and compliance guides

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Advocacy](https://www.ada.org/advocacy): ADA advocacy on dental policy, insurance, and workforce issues

## News & Professional Development

- [New Dentist News](https://www.ada.org/publications/new-dentist-news): News and career guidance for new dentists and dental students
- [New Dentist Blog](https://newdentistblog.ada.org): Blog covering dentist finances, loans, and career planning
- [Dental Sound Bites Podcast](https://www.ada.org/publications/dental-sound-bites): ADA podcast on dentistry trends and clinical practice topics

## Optional

- [Become a Volunteer Test Constructor](https://www.ada.org/education/testing/volunteer-test-constructor): Volunteer opportunity for dental exam test construction
- [Home](https://www.ada.org): ADA homepage with clinical guidelines, research, and industry news
